notes:
- Batch: before the start, videos that were moved or deleted, a disk that is almost full and a refused Gemini key are told at once – not half way through the queue.
- Batch: when the graphics card runs out of memory or its driver restarts, the video is tried again by itself and the rest of the queue runs one video at a time.
- Graphics cards under 7 GB: Paraformer-zh reads smaller pieces, and the next video waits while the card is almost full (less chance of a black screen).
- Batch report: "Time spent" is the time of this run (it added up every run before).
- Batch: right-click › ▶ Start these now works again (it showed "'bool' object is not iterable").
